participation.context: Left the paper, sat four minutes, and came away.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Was named as within and teaching, and was not in the lodge.
participation.name: John Florio

participation.context: Was named as at court, and was not in the lodge.
participation.name: Henry Wriothesley, 3rd Earl of Southampton

story.body: You gave the sealed paper to the porter for Master Florio and sat the four minutes. You did not go further in than the bench, and you did not see my lord.

title: Left the paper at the lodge and sat four minutes

story.body: You told yourself the errand was done as you turned from the gate, and you stopped. You did not rehearse it a second time.

participation.context: Struck the gloss, spared the first line, and left the margin blank of any figure.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You cut two lines that explained the oath, left the opening line, and wrote no figure in the margin.

title: Struck the gloss on the roll
